title: Wearables Platform Monitoring
description: Kafka, import service and db-lord health. Provisioned from gitops/apps/monitoring/grafana/dashboards.

panels.title: Kafka brokers online
panels.description: Brokers registered with the active KRaft controller. Red means a broker is down.

panels.title: Under-replicated partitions
panels.description: Partitions with fewer in-sync replicas than configured. Anything above 0 means a broker is lagging or down.

panels.title: Offline partitions
panels.description: Partitions without a leader; their data cannot be written or read.

panels.title: Uploads (24 h)
panels.description: Upload requests (POST /ingest) received by the import service in the last 24 hours.

panels.title: Upload server errors (1 h)
panels.description: Share of uploads in the last hour that failed with a 5xx status. Client errors (4xx) are not counted.

panels.title: Devices registered
panels.description: Devices in db-lord, counted every 15 minutes.

panels.title: Messages in per topic
panels.description: Messages written to each topic per second (summed over the partition leaders). Internal topics are hidden.

panels.title: Bytes in per topic
panels.description: Producer traffic per topic, before replication.

panels.title: Topic size on disk
panels.description: Log size per topic on one replica (largest broker copy). Turns yellow at 5 GiB and red at 10 GiB.

panels.title: Broker JVM heap used
panels.description: Heap in use per broker. The JVM collects garbage in waves, so short peaks are normal; it is stressed when it stays above 85 %.

panels.title: Broker network threads busy
panels.description: Share of time the network threads are busy (1 − idle). Red above 70 % means the brokers cannot keep up with client traffic.

panels.title: Broker CPU
panels.description: CPU cores used by each broker process.

panels.title: Failed produce / fetch requests
panels.description: Requests the brokers rejected. Should stay at 0.

panels.title: Upload rate by status
panels.description: Uploads (POST /ingest) per minute, stacked by HTTP status class.

panels.title: Status codes (selected time range)
panels.description: All requests by exact HTTP status code over the time range picked above. 401/403 are rejected tokens, 422 invalid payloads, 5xx service errors.

panels.title: Status class share
panels.description: Share of 2xx / 3xx / 4xx / 5xx responses over the selected time range.

panels.title: Upload latency (p50 / p95)
panels.description: Time the import service needs to accept an upload. Red above 2.5 s.

panels.title: Upload error share
panels.description: Share of uploads failing with 4xx (client, e.g. expired token) and 5xx (server).

panels.title: Registered devices over time
panels.description: Total devices in db-lord, sampled every 15 minutes. Steps show when new devices were registered.

panels.title: New devices per day
panels.description: Devices added per calendar day (difference of the daily maximum).

panels.title: Devices by status
panels.description: Current device inventory by hardware status.
